mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE > 0.2pp increase over 3 months) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative equity returns as corporate earnings growth slows within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.2pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate contraction in consumer and business demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through reduced earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and GDPC1 both decline in the last 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline.

mechanism_narrative: During supply chain disruption regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced manufacturing output, leading to negative equity returns over 60 trading days as corporate margins compress.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines in the last 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO declines in a supply chain disruption regime.

mechanism_narrative: An acceleration in CPI (CPIAUCSL > 0.5% increase over 1 month) signals inflationary pressures that prompt monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Joint declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through reduced consumption growth.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the last 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In labor market slack regimes, a sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as corporate investment declines.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% in a labor market slack regime.

mechanism_narrative: A low industrial production level (INDPRO < 100) indicates weak manufacturing activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through reduced corporate output growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100.
